branded.description:
Which answers to count, by the prompt as it ran: 'all' (default), 'branded' (the prompt names the brand) or 'non_branded'. A prompt is branded when its text names the brand: the registrable name of a target domain as a word, case ignored, so 'example' and 'example.com' both name example.com. Branded prompts almost always get answers that mention the brand.

* `all` - All
* `branded` - Branded
* `non_branded` - Non-branded

days.description: Length of the window in days, ending today in the project's timezone. Default 7, at most 90.

engine.description: Only count checks from this answer engine, for example 'claude-web-search'. Omit to count every engine.

keyword.description: Only count answers whose web searches contain this phrase, case ignored. Usually one of the project's keywords.

topic.description: Only count checks that ran with this prompt topic. A prompt moved to another topic keeps its past checks under the old one. An empty value counts the checks of prompts that had no topic. Omit to count every topic.
